a: Scope, time, and resources trade off; quality is not free.
Bring options: cut scope, add people, or move date.
Offer a thinner slice that still delivers learning/value.
List risks with owners and mitigations early.
Give ranges with assumptions, not false precision.
Define how new requests affect timeline and cost.
No + alternative preserves relationships better than soft maybes.
Agree how success will be measured before build.
